note: USD per million INPUT tokens, list price, read by gt_optimize_session.py to price prompt-cache writes found in Claude Code transcripts. Matched by substring in this order; the first match wins, so specific spellings come before family names. This file RECOGNISES model ids that already appear in transcripts; it never selects a model (that is packs/core/model.intents.pack.json). It is the one other file tests/test_gt_model.py lets carry model ids.
windows_note: Context window in tokens, [needle, window, verified], matched by substring in this order like prices (first match wins). verified true = read from the model catalog inside Claude Code 2.1.296 (self-verified from the binary, 2026-10-13, not from API docs). verified false = a conservative guess for a family spelling not in that catalog; the expiry guard's cold-compaction ladder uses it as is. The ladder lists the cheaper models to try first, smallest first; the session's own main model is always the last step.
